title: Ever since 4.6, my buildsystem configuration results in very bloated executables
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.1-rc1, 4.6.1, 4.7, 4.8.dev3, 4.8.dev5

### System information

N/A, see the workflow files used for CI

### Issue description

The same workflow file, simply with 4.6.stable changed to 4.6.1.rc1, results in the exported zip of my project going from 7.87 MB to 10.6 MB. This issue has remained ever since. I've posted below a github CI workflow file that produces similar result.

### Steps to reproduce

Sorry if this needs more of a MRP, I don't know how to do this for buildsystem issues. The workflow for my project looks like this (stripped down to just focus on web, where executable size is the most important):

```
name: export-optimized

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

env:
# If you change which part is commented out, the zip goes 8.64 MB --> 11.5 MB

#  GODOT_VERSION: 4.8
#  GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE: dev6
#  GODOT_COMMIT_HASH: 8898c2b3db32adf6f92c694ffb6dac19af672e5f
#  EMSDK_VERSION: latest

  GODOT_VERSION: 4.6
  GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE: stable
  GODOT_COMMIT_HASH: 89cea143987d564363e15d207438530651d943ac
  EMSDK_VERSION: 4.0.11

jobs:
  build-web:
    name: Export GodSVG for Web
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PLATFORM: "Web"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          path: godsvg

      - name: Set up Godot Editor
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/godot-editor
          cd ~/godot-editor
          wget -q https://github.com/godotengine/godot-builds/releases/download/${GODOT_VERSION}-${GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE}/Godot_v${GODOT_VERSION}-${GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE}_linux.x86_64.zip
          unzip Godot_v${GODOT_VERSION}-${GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE}_linux.x86_64.zip
          mv ./Godot_v${GODOT_VERSION}-${GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE}_linux.x86_64 ~/godot-editor/godot
          echo "~/godot-editor" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: sudo apt-get install -y scons python3

      - name: Clone Godot repository
        run: git clone https://github.com/godotengine/godot.git godot

      - name: Checkout specific commit
        run: |
          cd godot
          git fetch
          git checkout $GODOT_COMMIT_HASH

      - name: Set up Emscripten
        uses: emscripten-core/setup-emsdk@v16
        with:
          version: ${{ env.EMSDK_VERSION }}

      - name: Build Godot template for Web
        run: |
          cd godot
          scons p=web arch=wasm32 target=template_release lto=full production=yes deprecated=no minizip=no d3d12=no vulkan=no use_volk=no disable_3d=yes disable_physics_2d=yes disable_navigation_2d=yes modules_enabled_by_default=no module_freetype_enabled=yes module_gdscript_enabled=yes module_svg_enabled=yes module_jpg_enabled=yes module_webp_enabled=yes module_dds_enabled=yes module_text_server_adv_enabled=yes graphite=no module_mbedtls_enabled=yes threads=no
          mkdir -p ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/${GODOT_VERSION}.${GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE}/
          mv ./bin/godot.web.template_release.wasm32.nothreads.zip ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/${GODOT_VERSION}.${GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE}/web_nothreads_release.zip

      - name: Export project
        run: |
          cd godsvg
          mkdir -p build/web
          godot --headless --export-release "Web" build/web/Bloated.html
          cd build/web
          mv Bloated.html index.html

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: Bloated.Web
          path: godsvg/build/web
```

Simply changing `GODOT_VERSION` to `4.6.1`, `GODOT_RELEASE_TYPE` to `rc1`, and `GODOT_COMMIT_HASH` to, say, `6188f459b35219f0b40d6994ae85732da0718d46` (check out https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commits/4.6/?after=a80a06c3e819d5b77a1737441aec9ccf1d93eda7+320, the [libpng: Update to 1.6.54](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/6188f459b35219f0b40d6994ae85732da0718d46) commit which happened right after 4.6 stable) bloats the executable by nearly 3 megabytes, which is a huge deal for me.

So something weird happened with 4.6.1 rc1 and any further versions. Here's where I was trying to isolate this: https://github.com/MewPurPur/GodSVG/pull/1842

If I can do anything further to help isolate the issue, please tell me.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I don't have one
